title: MCP Hardened Read-Only Surface Release Gate v1 — Rig Relay
verdict: PASS — MCP read-only surface is hardened and gates are in place.

test_result.pre_existing_conftest_issue: tests/conftest.py cannot import AgentLoop due to parallel lane's dirty agent_loop.py. --noconftest flag required until that lane converges.

required_invariants: Descriptor integrity: every tool call and tools/list verifies descriptor hash; drift quarantines tool
Roots boundary: all filesystem-facing tools validate workspace root; path traversal/symlink escape refused
Content-light scan: every tool output classified; secret-bearing and forbidden-raw outputs refused
Receipt persistence: every MCP outcome persisted as ReceiptEnvelope when receipt_store provided
Local session auth: with require_auth=True, missing/invalid token refused before any other check
Pipeline order: auth → unknown tool → descriptor integrity → forbidden → tier gating → roots → dispatch → scan → receipt → response
Token safety: raw session token never leaked in any response, log, or error
Content-light classification: propagated into receipt metadata, not hardcoded to public_safe
Mutation blocked: mutation and git-release tiers permanently blocked regardless of auth state

mutation_tools_blocked.tier_4_mutation: blocked — cryptographic approval receipt required (not yet implemented)

hosted_oauth_deferred.reason: MCPToolAuthMetadata has bearer_supported and oauth_supported flags. No implementation exists. Local stdio session token is sufficient for v1 read-only surface.
hosted_oauth_deferred.next_when: When MCP moves to streamable HTTP transport or hosted deployments.

remaining_common_envelope_gaps: input_hash — not computed from request body
output_hash — not computed from response body
trace_id — not propagated from request params (present in stdio transport but not wired into envelope)

sync_handler_status.process_jsonrpc_sync: Handles tools/list, resources/list, prompts/list. Does NOT handle tools/call.
sync_handler_status.call_tool_sync: Exists and has full hardening pipeline (auth → descriptor → tier → dispatch → scan → receipt). Not wired into process_jsonrpc_sync.
sync_handler_status.impact: Sync clients cannot invoke MCP tools via process_jsonrpc_sync. They must use the async stdio path or call call_tool_sync directly.
sync_handler_status.fix: Wire call_tool_sync into process_jsonrpc_sync tools/call handler. Low blast radius (~5 lines).

unknown_tool_behavior_status.current: Returns JSON-RPC error {error, code: -32601} rather than structured refusal with content_light, surface, refusal_code, request_id, generated_at.
unknown_tool_behavior_status.impact: Unknown-tool errors are not schema-compatible with other refusal envelopes. Receipt persistence still works (persist_outcome is called).
unknown_tool_behavior_status.fix: Convert to structured refusal with refusal_code='unknown_tool' while preserving JSON-RPC error code -32601 in the response envelope. Low blast radius.

next_permitted_mcp_work.rationale: Trivial fix. Low blast radius. Unblocks sync MCP clients.
